children: Collector Crypt has scheduled a CARDS supply unlock for 29 Nov 2026. The release covers about 38.09 million CARDS. The tokens in this release are allocated to the project's advisors, investors and team members.
The amount being released is equal to 4.28% of the current circulating supply. Once the unlock takes effect, recipients can sell the CARDS from their unlocked allocations.

title: Collector Crypt: Unlocks About 38.09 Million CARDS - 29 Nov 2026
